<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Farming Game</title>
    <style>
        canvas {
            border: 1px solid black;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <canvas id="gameCanvas" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        const gridSize = 32;
        const player = { x: 0, y: 0 };
        const tiles = {};
        const inventory = { seeds: 5, crops: 0 };
        let day = 0;

        function drawPlayer() {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'green';
            ctx.fillRect(player.x * gridSize, player.y * gridSize, gridSize, gridSize);
        }

        function drawTile(x, y, crop, stage) {
            ctx.fillStyle = crop === 'seed' ? 'yellow' : 'green';
            ctx.fillRect(x * gridSize, y * gridSize, gridSize, gridSize);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
            ctx.font = '12px Arial';
            ctx.fillText(`Stage: ${stage}`, x * gridSize + 10, y * gridSize + 20);
        }

        function drawInventory() {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'blue';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 100, 100);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
            ctx.font = '12px Arial';
            ctx.fillText(`Seeds: ${inventory.seeds}`, 10, 20);
            ctx.fillText(`Crops: ${inventory.crops}`, 10, 40);
        }

        function draw() {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            drawPlayer();
            for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(tiles)) {
                drawTile(key.split(',')[0], key.split(',')[1], value.crop, value.stage);
            }
            drawInventory();
            document.getElementById('day').textContent = `Day: ${day}`;
        }

        function movePlayer(event) {
            const dx = event.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? -1 : event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : 0;
            const dy = event.key === 'ArrowUp' ? -1 : event.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : 0;
            const newX = player.x + dx;
            const newY = player.y + dy;
            if (newX >= 0 && newX < 20 && newY >= 0 && newY < 15) {
                player.x = newX;
                player.y = newY;
                draw();
            }
        }

        function plantSeed() {
            const tileKey = `${player.x},${player.y}`;
            if (!tiles[tileKey]) {
                tiles[tileKey] = { crop: 'seed', stage: 1 };
                draw();
            }
        }

        function advanceTime() {
            day++;
            draw();
        }

        function harvestCrop() {
            const tileKey = `${player.x},${player.y}`;
            if (tiles[tileKey] && tiles[tileKey].crop === 'seed') {
                tiles[tileKey] = { crop: 'empty', stage: 0 };
                inventory.seeds++;
                inventory.crops--;
                draw();
            }
        }

        function saveGame() {
            localStorage.setItem('game', JSON.stringify({ player, tiles, inventory, day }));
        }

        function loadGame() {
            const savedGame = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('game'));
            player = savedGame.player;
            tiles = savedGame.tiles;
            inventory = savedGame.inventory;
            day = savedGame.day;
            draw();
        }

        document.addEventListener('keydown', movePlayer);
// p plants: if the player's tile is empty and inventory.seeds > 0, set tiles[x+','+y] = { crop: 'wheat', stage: 0 } and do inventory.seeds--; otherwise change nothing.
        document.addEventListener('keydown', plantSeed);
// a advances time: day++; draw();.
        document.addEventListener('keydown', advanceTime);
// h harvests crop: if the player's tile is 'wheat' and inventory.crops > 0, set tiles[x+','+y] = { crop: 'empty', stage: 0 } and do inventory.crops--; otherwise change nothing.
        document.addEventListener('keydown', harvestCrop);
// s saves game: localStorage.setItem('game', JSON.stringify({ player, tiles, inventory, day }));
        document.addEventListener('keydown', saveGame);
// l loads game: const savedGame = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('game')); player = savedGame.player; tiles = savedGame.tiles; inventory = savedGame.inventory; day = savedGame.day; draw();.
        document.addEventListener('keydown', loadGame);
        document.addEventListener('keydown', () => {
            if (inventory.seeds > 0) {
                plantSeed();
            } else {
                alert('Not enough seeds!');
            }
        });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', () => {
            if (inventory.crops > 0) {
                harvestCrop();
            } else {
                alert('Not enough crops!');
            }
        });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', () => {
            advanceTime();
        });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', () => {
            saveGame();
        });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', () => {
            loadGame();
        });

        window.game = { state: () => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({ player, tiles, inventory, day })) };
    </script>
</body>
</html>
